title: Integral scalar extension along a finite extension of l-adic fields
statement:
Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\Ql$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L$, put $A_{L,m}=\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m$, and let $Y$ be a scheme. For every $m\geq1$ the ring map $\mathcal O_E\to A_{L,m}$ factors through $A_{E,n}$ for $n$ large (since $\varpi_E^n\in\varpi_L^m\mathcal O_L$), so $(A_{L,m})_Y$ is a sheaf of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-algebras on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ choose a K-flat complex $P\to K$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules (as in [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]) and put $K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{L,m}=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}(A_{L,m})_Y\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{L,m})$; the reductions $A_{L,m+1}\to A_{L,m}$ give transition maps $\operatorname{Res}_{m+1}(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{L,m+1})\to\operatorname{Res}_m(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{L,m})$ in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_L)$, $\operatorname{Res}_m$ the restriction of scalars along $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,Y}\to(A_{L,m})_Y$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The *integral scalar extension* is

$$
 K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L=R\varprojlim_m\operatorname{Res}_m\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{L,m}\bigr)\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_L),
$$

the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit]; on morphisms it is the induced map, and it is an $\mathcal O_E$-linear functor $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_L)$ (with $\mathcal O_E$ acting on the target through $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$).

source.place: last paragraph ('defined on integral representatives by completed derived tensor product with $\mathcal O_L$, levelwise modulo powers of the two uniformizers'); the formula is the one stated in dag node lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension

mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.extendScalars for modules over a ring; no extension of scalars for complexes of sheaves on a site, no derived limit of a tower of derived reductions
